notes.title: Making Falos Free
notes.content: [p]We’re excited to share that [b]Falos[/b], our educational game designed to make language learning fun and engaging, will [b]100% free to play[/b] for all players.[/p][p][b]Why are we making this change?[/b][/p][p]Falos was created to help people explore new languages and build confidence through play. By removing the purchase price, we hope to reach even more learners around the world—whether you’re studying for school, work, or just personal curiosity.[/p][p][b]What is Falos?[/b][/p][p]Falos is an interactive language-learning tool to learn basic vocabulary in a language. [/p][p][b]What does this mean for current owners?[/b][/p][p]If you previously purchased Falos, thank you for supporting our work early on. Your contribution helped us improve the game and make it available to a wider audience. [/p][p][b]Thank you![/b][/p][p]Thank you for being part of our community, and we hope you’ll share Falos with anyone who wants to learn something new.[/p][p]💬 If you have any questions or suggestions, drop us a message or join the discussion on our community hub![/p][p][b]Happy learning![/b][/p]

notes.title: Update Notes - 2024.10.15
notes.content:
Several small changes were made to improve the game including:

[list]
[*] Making the buttons visible in the menu after a level is completed (Victory Menu)
[*] Hiding the music volume control in the settings. No music is currently in the game and this confused players.
[*] Making improvements to how the list of languages is displayed. 
[/list]
